name: Csánig (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csánig: a crowned blue shield with a white crane, ears of grain and waves, above a yellow scroll inscribed CSÁNIG.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Csánig arms with crown and scroll
